subject: mathematics
question_text: Let a = 2i + 4j − 5k, b = i + j + k and c = j + 2k. Find the unit vector in the opposite direction of a + b + c.

recall_prompt: Say how you would find a unit vector in the OPPOSITE direction to a sum.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Add and find the magnitude
steps.margin_note: First mark. c has no i term — write it as 0i + j + 2k so the columns line up. The magnitude comes out to exactly 7, which is a good sign the addition is right.

recall.must_convey: That the three vectors are added to give 3i + 6j − 2k, whose magnitude is 7.
accept: add all three to get three i plus six j minus two k and the magnitude is seven
the sum is three i plus six j minus two k with length seven
add the three vectors then take the modulus which is seven
moodu vectors add cheste three i plus six j minus two k, magnitude seven
write c as zero i plus j plus two k and add

steps.why: Writing the missing component as 0 rather than leaving a gap is what keeps the addition aligned. The magnitude landing on a whole number is the arithmetic checking itself.
common_mistakes: Dropping c entirely because it has no i term.
Sign slip on the k column: −5 + 1 + 2 = −2.

steps.label: Divide and reverse the sign
steps.margin_note: Second mark, and the point of the question. Opposite direction means a minus sign in front of the whole thing — the length stays 1, only the direction flips.
lines: Opposite unit vector = −(a + b + c)/|a + b + c|

recall.must_convey: That the unit vector is divided by 7 AND negated, because the question asked for the opposite direction.
accept: divide by seven and put a minus sign in front for the opposite direction
the opposite unit vector is minus three i plus six j minus two k all over seven
negate the unit vector to reverse the direction
minus sign petti seven tho divide cheyyali, opposite direction ki
flip the sign of the unit vector

steps.why: Multiplying a vector by −1 reverses it without changing its length. That single minus sign is the whole difference between this question and the previous one.
common_mistakes: Giving the unit vector without the minus sign.
Negating only one component instead of the whole vector.
